spans.s:
रेचक a. (चिका f.) [रेचयति
रिच्णिच् ण्वुल्]
1 Emptying, purging.
--2
Purgative, aperient.
--3 Emptying
the lungs, emitting the breath.
--कः
1 Emission of breath, breathing out,
exhalation, especially through one
of the nostrils (opp. पूरक which
means ‘inhaling breath’, and कुंभक
‘suspending breath’).
--2 A syringe.
--3 Nitre, salt-petre.
--कं A
purgative, cathartic.

रेचनं, --ना [रिच्-ल्युट्]
1 Emptying.
--2 Loosening, diminishing.
--3
Emitting the breath.
--4 Purging.
--5 Evacuation.

रेचनं, --ना [रिच्-ल्युट्]
1 Emptying.
--2 Loosening, diminishing.
--3
Emitting the breath.
--4 Purging.
--5 Evacuation.

रेचित a. Emptied, cleared.
--तं
horse's gallop.
